definitions.explanation: A wire or cable used to transmit electricity. Includes both overhead power lines and electrical wiring.

examples.japanese: {電線|でんせん}に{鳥|とり}がとまっている。
examples.english: A bird is perching on the power line.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{電線|でんせん}が{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The power line was severed by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{電線|でんせん}を{地下|ちか}に{埋|う}める{工事|こうじ}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: In this area, work is underway to bury the power lines underground.

notes:
In Japan, overhead {電線|でんせん} are a common sight in cities and are sometimes noted as a characteristic of the urban landscape. There is an ongoing effort to bury them underground ({無電柱化|むでんちゅうか}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{電線|でんせん}が{切|き}れる (power line snaps)
・{電線|でんせん}を{引|ひ}く (run electric wire)
・{電線|でんせん}に{触|さわ}る (touch a wire — dangerous)
